transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… I’ve been feeling pretty shut down. Like the part of me that used to want to reach out to people, or enjoy work, yoga, galleries, even writing in my journal… it’s all gotten very quiet. I’m mostly just getting through what I have to do.
Have you noticed a decrease in your interest or enjoyment in activities like yoga, going to galleries, or writing in your journal?

Yes… I have. Those things used to feel like they pulled me toward them a little—yoga, galleries, even just writing things down. Now it’s more like… I do what I’m supposed to do, but I don’t really feel much interest in it. Even with work and people, that part of me feels very quiet.
Have you also been feeling down, hopeless, or blaming yourself more than usual?
I don’t know… not really hopeless, I guess. I haven’t noticed blaming myself more than usual. It’s more just… flat. Hard to explain.
Have you noticed that you feel more fatigued or that you’ve lost your usual energy, even when doing things that didn’t used to tire you out?

A little, maybe. It’s not exactly like being physically tired all the time… more like I don’t have the usual pull toward things. Work, yoga, galleries, even journaling—it all feels like obligations now, and I’m mostly just moving through them.
Do you find that you feel less pleasure or interest in most things, even things you used to enjoy?

Yes… I think so. It’s not dramatic, exactly. It’s just like the part of me that used to want to reach for people, or enjoy my work, yoga, galleries, writing… it’s gone very quiet. Mostly I just go through what I have to do.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep, appetite, or concentration lately? Or any thoughts of hurting yourself?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really been tracking sleep or appetite that closely. Concentration is… maybe not great, but I don’t know. And no, I’m not thinking about hurting myself.
How long have you been feeling this way — this sense of things feeling quiet and less enjoyable?
Maybe… about eight months. It kind of started after we had my older relative move into our apartment, and since then my thinking and work and… being with people has just felt different. Quieter.
Can you tell me more about how you feel when you do the things you used to enjoy, like yoga or writing in your journal? Do you feel any pleasure or interest in them anymore?

Not really… I still sometimes do them, like yoga or writing, but it feels more like checking something off. The part of me that used to actually want to do it, or feel something from it, has gone pretty quiet. I’m mostly just moving through obligations.
Can you describe how your sleep has been lately — do you find it hard to fall asleep, stay asleep, or do you sleep more than usual?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been paying close attention to it. Some nights feel a little off, but I couldn’t say if I’m sleeping more or less, exactly.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough or blaming yourself for things more than usual?
I don’t know… not especially. I mean, I have moments where I wonder if I’m not handling things well, but I wouldn’t say I’m blaming myself more than usual.
Would you say that you’re experiencing a loss of pleasure in almost all activities, even ones you used to really enjoy?

Yeah… I think so. It’s not that I never do anything, but the part of me that used to want to reach for people, or enjoy my work, yoga, galleries, even journaling… it’s gone pretty quiet. Mostly I just get through what I’m supposed to do.
Would you say that you’ve been feeling a lack of energy or fatigue nearly every day, even when you haven’t been doing much?
I don’t really know. I wouldn’t say I’ve noticed being tired every day like that… maybe a bit worn down sometimes, but I haven’t been tracking it.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently — like eating more or less than usual or gaining or losing weight without trying?
I haven’t really noticed anything clear. My eating’s maybe a little irregular, but I don’t think there’s been a big change in weight or anything.
Have you noticed any difficulties with thinking clearly or concentrating lately — like your mind feels slowed down or it’s harder to focus on tasks?
I’m not sure. I don’t think my thinking feels slowed down exactly… focus comes and goes, but I haven’t really noticed a clear change.
Have you noticed that it’s harder to think clearly or concentrate lately — like your mind feels foggy or it’s tougher to focus on what you’re doing?
I mean… not really in a way I can pin down. Sometimes it’s harder to stay with something, but I wouldn’t say my mind feels foggy exactly.
Would you say that you’ve experienced a loss of pleasure or interest in nearly all activities, even those you used to really enjoy?

Yeah… I think so. It’s not dramatic exactly, but the part of me that used to want to see people, or get something out of work, yoga, going to galleries, even journaling… it’s just gone kind of quiet. Mostly I’m just doing what I have to do.
Have you noticed that you're moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or that you can't get yourself to do things as quickly as you used to?

Not so much slower, exactly. It’s more that I don’t… reach for things the way I used to. Work, yoga, galleries, even journaling — I mostly just get through what I have to do. That’s part of why I came in.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight over the past several months, like a decrease in appetite or weight loss without trying?
I haven’t really noticed anything significant. My appetite seems… mostly the same, I think. My weight hasn’t changed in any way I’ve been paying attention to.
